rationale: Field service app for telecom technicians (Lousa Mobile). Requires extreme clarity, large touch targets, high contrast for outdoor visibility, and thumb-zone ergonomics for one-handed operation. Color semantics use slate/sky/amber/emerald.

typography.captions: text-[11px] sm:text-[12px] font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500

spacing_and_layout.cards: rounded-[12px] bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-[12px] sm:p-[14px] flex flex-col gap-[8px] sm:gap-[12px]

StepIndicator.styles: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 flex flex-col gap-2
StepIndicator.structure: Text 'Etapa X de N · [Nome]' (font-medium text-slate-900 text-[13px]) + thin progress bar (h-1.5 w-full bg-slate-100 rounded-full, inner bar bg-sky-600 rounded-full transition-all duration-300)

StickyCTABar.description: Thumb-zone sticky bottom bar for primary navigation.
StickyCTABar.styles: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 p-4 shadow-[0_-8px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] max-w-[420px] mx-auto flex gap-3 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]
StickyCTABar.structure: Secondary 'Voltar' button (w-1/3 min-h-[48px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 rounded-lg font-medium) + Primary 'Próximo'/'Finalizar' button (w-2/3 min-h-[48px] bg-sky-600 text-white rounded-lg font-bold shadow-sm)

SectionCard.description: Uniform card wrapper for inputs and content.
SectionCard.styles: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-[12px] p-4 shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)] mb-4 flex flex-col gap-4

FieldStockBadge.description: Badge showing delta/stock info inline above or beside numerical inputs.
FieldStockBadge.styles: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200

Header.description: Dark header showing ticket summary. Preserved from original but visually refined.
Header.styles: bg-slate-900 text-white p-5 rounded-b-[16px] mb-5 shadow-md flex flex-col gap-2
elements: Client Name (text-lg font-bold)
Address & GPS link (text-sky-300 text-sm flex items-center gap-1)
Phone (text-slate-300 text-sm)
Live Signal Indicator (SmartOLT badge style)

Step_1_ONT.title: Sinal & Equipamento
Step_1_ONT.layout: Large unified SectionCard acting as a hub for the ONT data capture to remove the 'empty' feeling.
elements: Title: 'Identificação do Equipamento' (text-slate-900 font-semibold)
Empty State/Current Data: Bold display of MAC/SN if available (bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[100px] mb-2)
Action Group (Stacked full-width for large tap targets):
1. LER ETIQUETA (IA Vision) - Primary action, bg-sky-600 text-white min-h-[48px] rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center gap-2
2. DIGITAR MANUAL - Secondary, bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 min-h-[48px] rounded-lg
3. SELECIONAR DO ESTOQUE - Secondary, bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 min-h-[48px] rounded-lg

Step_2_OsCtoPicker.title: CTO Mapa
elements: Leaflet Map container (rounded-[12px] overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 h-[350px] w-full z-10 relative shadow-sm)
Blue map pins for existing CTOs

Floating Action Button (FAB) or prominent CTA placed immediately below the map: 'Cadastrar CTO/CE/Cabo na Rede' (bg-orange-500 text-white font-semibold min-h-[48px] rounded-lg mt-4 w-full shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2)

Step_3_CTO_Portas.title: Porta CTO
Step_3_CTO_Portas.layout: Dense grid of ports with clear status colors.
elements: Header: 'Selecione a Porta Livre'
Grid layout for ports (grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2)
Available Port: border border-sky-200 bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 font-mono text-center rounded-md py-3 min-h-[44px]
Occupied Port: border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-400 font-mono text-center rounded-md py-3 min-h-[44px] opacity-70 cursor-not-allowed

Step_4_Insumos.title: Finalização
Step_4_Insumos.layout: Collapsible Shadcn Accordions to manage cognitive load.

sections.name: Troca ONT
sections.content: Auto-fill removed MAC (read-only field, bg-slate-50 text-slate-500) + Select new MAC from stock. Inner padding reduced to p-4 (removing old 80px).

sections.name: Fotos (Wizard)
sections.content: 3 mandatory photos (CTO, Equip, SN). Transitioned from error language (red) to pending/warning language (bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-800). Shows green check (bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700) when AI validates.

sections.name: Insumos FTTH
sections.content: Grid layout (grid-cols-2 gap-4) for numerical inputs (Drop, Esticador, Fast, Cabo, Conector Rede). Each input is stacked vertically: Label -> FieldStockBadge -> Input(type='number', min-h-[44px]).

sections.name: Observações
sections.content: Full width textarea (min-h-[100px] border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3).

PreSubmissionSummary.description: Final review block shown at the end of Step 4 before 'Finalizar nota'.
elements: Title: 'Resumo da OS' (text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 mb-3)
Read-only list (flex flex-col gap-2 text-[13px] bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200)
Row format: flex justify-between items-center. Label (text-slate-500) | Value (text-slate-900 font-medium)
Visual confirmation of 3/3 photos attached (emerald checkmarks)
Total materials used summary

interactions.toast: Use Sonner for inline notifications. Success (emerald), Info (sky), Warning (amber). Replace intrusive red banners.
interactions.loading: Inline spinners (lucide Loader2 animate-spin) inside buttons (e.g. while IA reads photo) or skeleton blocks (animate-pulse bg-slate-200) for loading CTO data.
interactions.transitions: Subtle fade-in for step content. Avoid heavy horizontal slides to prevent jank on low-end mobile devices.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT modify existing logic, state management, or API calls.
Apply Tailwind classes to existing `.js` components.
Preserve inline `style={...}` where refactoring is too complex, just append tailwind classes using template literals `className={`... ${...}`}`.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, accordions).
Use standard Radix/Shadcn Accordion structure for Step 4.
Always apply min-h-[44px] for all tappable elements to ensure mobile accessibility.
Maintain the layout strictly within max-w-[420px] mx-auto for desktop viewing consistency of the PWA.
